title: Who India Graduates — Research Report No. 1
description: How many students graduate in Arts, Science, Commerce and Engineering in India each year. Official AISHE 2022-23 and 2023-24 data: about 5.5 Arts/Science/Commerce graduates for every engineering graduate.
target_audience: Students choosing a stream or degree, parents, teachers and counsellors
questions_it_answers: How many students graduate in Arts, Science, Commerce and Engineering in India?
Which degree do most Indian students graduate in?
How many women graduate from Indian colleges?
Where can I find official higher education data?
